title: How you can turn AI Video to Game Ready Spritesheet for free :)
author: One_Enthusiasm9420
selftext:
I saw someone here was taking money for turning ai videos to spritesheet so i made a free version just use any video generation and paste it 

  
more free dev tools coming soon

comments.author: phmsanctified
comments.body: Nice! Will give it a try today!

comments.author: Aineisa
comments.body: It’s not exactly free if part of the flow requires top up lol

replies.author: One_Enthusiasm9420
replies.body: You can just generate video outside of AnimateMesh. It does not require a topup.

comments.author: Useful_Use_6170
comments.body: Will this work with top down ? I’m having a hard time getting good animations, will pay someone to teach me.

replies.author: One_Enthusiasm9420
replies.body:
for top-down i would recommend doing 3d to 2d, check this tutorial  
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Iyp2s57lEUw&t=1s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Iyp2s57lEUw&t=1s)

comments.author: IcWhyyy
comments.body: So sick of these self promotion posts, the animations always look like crap and  they require tons of credits.

replies.author: One_Enthusiasm9420
replies.body:
According to docs  
Grok video generation (powered by **Grok Imagine**) costs between **$0.05 and $0.07 per second**

  
You can also use any other ai video generator on the internet that is free.

replies.author: IcWhyyy
replies.body: I am not trying to be mean it's just that I tried some subscription based websites before znd they are a waste of money, they don't look good and require allot of cleanup.

comments.author: Disposable110
comments.body: Everyone that posts something that is not completely free and open source on github needs to be banned, I'm sick and tired of this commercial spam.
